description:
Create a 'Staff Picks' block on the homepage that displays 3 specific high-value products.

1. Edit the following products and mark them as 'Promoted to front page':
   - Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones
   - Apple MacBook Pro 16"
   - Canon EOS R6 Mirrorless Camera

2. Create a new View named 'Staff Picks' showing Commerce Products.
   - Create a Block display.
   - Filter criteria: Promoted to front page = True.
   - Sort criteria: Newest first (Authored on Descending).
   - Pager: Display exactly 3 items.
   - Format: Rendered entity (Teaser) or Grid.

3. Place the 'Staff Picks' block in the 'Content' region of the 'Olivero' theme layout so it appears on the homepage.

The site is available at http://localhost. Log in with admin / Admin1234!
